metadata.trained_on: Nothing — fitted per image at inference time (unsupervised).

notes: Aleatoric-dominated: single-pass entropy conflates data ambiguity with model ignorance and does not isolate epistemic uncertainty.
Levels 1 and 2 are aggregations of the same Level 3 field, so the hierarchy is internally consistent by construction.
Level 2 regions are connected components of the high-uncertainty mask unless a detection adapter supplied real objects.

assumptions: Exchangeability: the calibration samples and the test image must be exchangeable. Distribution shift violates this, and the coverage/risk guarantee does not hold when it is violated.
Monotone loss: the per-sample loss must be non-increasing in the threshold parameter lambda (Angelopoulos et al., ICLR 2024).
Marginal, not conditional: the guarantee holds on average over images, not for any individual image, region or patient subgroup.
The shipped calibration set is synthetic (procedural phantoms). Numbers derived from it characterise phantom behaviour, not clinical performance.

indicators.name: Intensity Wasserstein-1 distance
indicators.description: Earth-mover distance between the test and reference intensity histograms; measures how far intensity mass has moved.

indicators.name: Jensen-Shannon distance
indicators.description: Bounded, symmetric divergence between the histograms; sensitive to new intensity modes that leave the mean unchanged.

indicators.name: Standardised moment deviation
indicators.description: Mean/std/skew/kurtosis distance from the reference, expressed in units of the reference set's own dispersion.

indicators.name: Edge-density deviation
indicators.description: Mean gradient-magnitude difference; a proxy for resolution and reconstruction-kernel differences between scanners.

notes: Input-space intensity statistics only; semantic shift that preserves intensity statistics will not be detected.
confidence_degradation and uncertainty_increase are heuristic couplings of the shift score, NOT measured performance drops.

Reference domain 'synthetic_reference_v1': 64 procedural phantoms (seed 4242). Defines 'in-distribution' as phantom-like. NOT derived from any clinical dataset, hospital or scanner; replace via set_reference_profile() before drawing conclusions.

factors.name: Mean predictive uncertainty
factors.rationale: Mean normalised predictive entropy over all pixels. Higher means the model's own distribution is closer to uniform.

factors.name: Low model confidence
factors.rationale: Mean max-class probability, rescaled from the achievable range [0.5, 1.0] so a confident binary decision scores 0.

factors.name: Input-domain shift
factors.rationale: Composite intensity-domain shift score. Shift breaks the exchangeability the calibration guarantee depends on.

factors.name: Calibration error
factors.rationale: Expected Calibration Error on the calibration set, saturating at ECE=0.20. Measured on synthetic phantoms unless a real calibration split is registered.
